svg.text: Systems Realization of Multimodal Agent Memory
from logical memory objects to physical state, movement, and reuse
materialization on the read path · commit on the write path
a residency change moves bytes without changing the logical memory state
physical placement is orthogonal to logical representation — the same logical memory may be replicated across tiers
cost = bytes moved × effective bandwidth, overlapped with computation or traded against recompute
Logical memory type is defined by the operative representation supplied to computation, not by where its bytes reside; indices and stores realize access without defining a new memory type.
